name: Laplacian Frequency Hierarchies
aliases: Laplacian Frequency Hierarchies for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A frequency-decomposed training scheme for 3DGS that decomposes image supervision into a low-frequency base component and high-frequency residual components, optimized by frequency-specific Gaussian fields, and composed in the image domain for novel view synthesis.
summary: Laplacian Frequency Hierarchies is a 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization that factorizes scenes into frequency-specific fields, archiving lower-frequency layers to reduce active Gaussian counts and memory usage during high-frequency training.
